Evaluability is claim and design specific. Membership availability alone cannot establish alpha reachability. Missing registry rows carry no conclusion.

```{r}
library(gbm201data)
x <- gbm_evaluability()
x[, c("model_instance_id", "evaluable", "stop_reason")]
```
